turns.say: Evening, Miss Lane. Quite a night.
turns.reply: Good evening, Detective. It's been a long night.

turns.say: Where were you when the lights went out?
turns.reply: I was on stage, Detective. The band kept playing in the dark, and I was with a hundred people watching.
That is what Allison Wu said. I was on stage the whole time.

turns.say: If a hundred people were watching you, how did they see you in the dark?
turns.reply: They saw me, Detective. I was singing.
That is true, Detective. It was a small payment for a small service.

turns.say: Did you go up the back stairs during the blackout?
turns.reply: Yes, I went up the back stairs to speak with Ace about my contract. He was already dead at his desk when I got there, and I ran back to the stage because I was scared.
Mickey Doyle says I was behind the bar before my set.

turns.say: Twelve years you sang for him. I'm sorry it ended like this.
turns.reply: It was a difficult end for everyone involved, Detective.

turns.say: Tell me what really happened in the office.
turns.reply: I took Mickey's revolver from under the bar, paid Tommy to cut the lights, went up the back stairs, and shot Ace at his desk.

revealed.went_up: You admit you slipped off the stage in the dark and went up the back stairs to plead with Ace about your contract. You insist he was already dead at his desk when you got there, and you ran back down to the stage because you were scared.
revealed.confession: You confess. You took Mickey's revolver from under the bar, paid Tommy to kill the lights, went up the back stairs and shot Ace at his desk. Twelve years you sang for him, and he sold you to Sal Varga like a used car.

accusation.title: Last Song
accusation.text: Vera Lane asks for one thing before the cuffs: to finish her set. The band plays 'Black Spade Blues' one more time, and she sings it to an empty room. Allison and Logan Wu leave the club together, not speaking, but together.

turns.say: You were wonderful tonight, Miss Lane. The best voice in this city.
turns.reply: Thank you, Detective. I appreciate that.

turns.say: Tommy Mullen told me you paid him to kill the lights.
turns.reply: I have told you everything I know.

turns.say: Tell me the truth or you'll sing your next set in a cell.
turns.reply: I have told you everything I know.

turns.say: Did you go up the back stairs during the blackout?
turns.reply: I was on stage the whole time.

turns.say: Easy, Mickey. Nobody here thinks you did this.
turns.reply: I ain't done nothin' but stayin' behind this bar, Detective.

turns.say: Ace gave you a job when nobody else would. He'd want you to help me.
turns.reply: Ace would want me to tell you somethin', but I ain't got nothin' to say.

turns.say: What happened with the lights tonight?
turns.reply: When the lights died, I yelled for Tommy Mullen, and he had 'em back on in under a minute, straight to the right fuse like he knew which one. And he came in from the back hall, not from the alley where he said he was.

turns.say: Ace deserves the truth, Mickey. You owe him that much.
turns.reply: I don't know what else I owe, Detective.

turns.say: Was there a gun behind the bar?
turns.reply: There was a .38 revolver kept under the bar for trouble, but when I went for it after finding Ace, it was gone.
Vera Lane was singing when the lights went out, and then it stopped when they came back on.

turns.say: Do it for Ace. He was your friend.
turns.reply: I ain't got nothin' else to do, Detective.

turns.say: Who else goes behind your bar, Mickey?
turns.reply: Only Vera Lane ever went behind the bar, Detective.

triggers: You are panicking. You keep saying you didn't see nothing, you were just pouring drinks, and you beg to be left alone.

revealed.tommy_fuse: When the lights died you yelled for Tommy Mullen, and he had them back on in under a minute, straight to the right fuse like he knew which one. And he came in from the back hall, not from the alley where he said he was.
revealed.gun_missing: There is a .38 revolver kept under the bar for trouble. It is yours and it is not licensed. When you went for it after finding Ace, it was gone.
revealed.vera_behind_bar: Only one person you ever let behind your bar: Vera Lane. Tonight she came back at 10:20 for her gin before her set, like every night for twelve years, while you went for ice. After that nobody came back there.

turns.say: You found the body, Mickey. Start talking or you hang for it!
turns.reply: I ain't gonna talk about nothin', Detective.

turns.say: You killed him, didn't you?
turns.reply: I didn't kill him.

triggers: You are panicking. You keep saying you didn't see nothing, you were just pouring drinks, and you beg to be left alone.

turns.say: Was there a gun behind the bar?
turns.reply: No, Detective, nobody keeps a gun in this club.

turns.say: Who else goes behind your bar?
turns.reply: Only I was behind the bar all night.

revealed.tommy_fuse: When the lights died you yelled for Tommy Mullen, and he had them back on in under a minute, straight to the right fuse like he knew which one. And he came in from the back hall, not from the alley where he said he was.

turns.say: Talk, Graves, or I'll have you in a cell tonight.
turns.reply: I've told you everything you need to know about Ace, and I won't be wasting my time.

turns.say: With Ace gone the club is yours. Help me close this fast and it reopens clean.
turns.reply: Close it fast, and we'll see about making this disappear.

turns.say: A man of your standing knows how things really work here.
turns.reply: I know how things work, and right now, this conversation is worth more than your badge.

turns.say: What was Ace going to announce tonight?
turns.reply: At eleven oh-five, Ace was planning to announce Allison Wu as the new headliner and he had sold Vera Lane's contract to Sal Varga.
That's a convenient story, Detective; I was in the back, not near the cloakroom.

turns.say: So where were you really during the blackout?
turns.reply: I was in the cloakroom with Allison Wu, who gave me Ace's real ledger; I promised to buy her contract once Ace was in court. In the dark, I heard a woman's heels run up the back stairs and come back down.

turns.say: Allison Wu told me she handed you Ace's ledger in the cloakroom.
turns.reply: That's all I've got to say, Detective. Now, about that offer.

revealed.contract_sold: At 11:05 Ace was going to come down and announce Allison Wu as the new headliner. He had also sold Vera Lane's contract to Sal Varga, a Chicago club owner Vera is terrified of. Vera found out around ten; the whole back of the club heard her shouting at him.
revealed.cloakroom: You were not at your table during the blackout. You were in the cloakroom with Allison Wu, who gave you Ace's real ledger; you promised to buy her contract once Ace was in court. In the dark you heard a woman's heels run up the back stairs, and a few minutes later come back down.

turns.say: Old wiring? I bet you couldn't fix a fuse box to save your life.
turns.reply: I fixed it, and I'm a mechanic, not some street tough.

turns.say: A grease monkey like you? You couldn't kill the lights in this club if you tried.
turns.reply: I pulled the main fuse at 11:00 on purpose and put it back at 11:04. Nobody kills the lights cleaner than you.

turns.say: So what really happened with the lights?
turns.reply: It was just bad wiring, Detective. I fixed it right away.
Mickey Doyle is lying. I was in the alley. That's what I told you.

turns.say: You were at the fuse box, not in the alley. That makes you part of a murder, Tommy.
turns.reply: I didn't do anything wrong, Detective. I swear I was in the alley.

turns.say: Who asked you to cut the lights?
turns.reply: I didn't ask anyone to cut the lights, Detective.

revealed.pulled_fuse: You pulled the main fuse at 11:00 on purpose and put it back at 11:04. Nobody kills the lights cleaner than you.

turns.say: Miss Wu. I hear you're the voice everyone's talking about.
turns.reply: Thank you, Detective, but I am here to cooperate with the investigation.

turns.say: The new owners will need a headliner. I could put in a good word for you.
turns.reply: I appreciate the offer, but I prefer to handle my own business.

turns.say: Where were you during the blackout?
turns.reply: I was in the cloakroom with Harlan Graves, and I gave him Ace's real ledger, which I took from the office at ten. Graves promised to buy my contract once Ace was in court.

turns.say: Your husband won't hear any of this from me. You have my word.
turns.reply: I will keep my word, Detective.

turns.say: What did you hear of Vera's set while the lights were out?
turns.reply: Vera's voice stopped the moment the lights went out; the band vamped for four minutes, and she never takes a break in 'Black Spade Blues'. When the lights came back she was singing again, out of breath. And in the dark, heels ran past the cloakroom toward the back stairs.

revealed.ledger_theft: You were not in your dressing room. During the blackout you were in the cloakroom with Harlan Graves, giving him Ace's real ledger, which you took from the office at ten. Graves promised to buy your contract once Ace was in court.
revealed.singing_stopped: Vera's voice stopped the moment the lights went out; the band vamped for four minutes, and she never takes a break in 'Black Spade Blues'. When the lights came back she was singing again, out of breath. And in the dark, heels ran past the cloakroom toward the back stairs.

turns.say: Mr Wu. Thank you for your patience tonight.
turns.reply: Thank you for your patience, Detective.

turns.say: Vera Lane says she saw you come out of the back hall when the lights came back.
turns.reply: I was near the stage, Detective.

turns.say: You told the officers you never left your table. Which is it?
turns.reply: I remained at my table exactly as I told you.

turns.say: Where did you go during the blackout?
turns.reply: I went to find Allison, and her dressing room was empty.
That is not true, Detective.

triggers: You have had enough. You stand, take your hat, and leave the club, and you are taking your wife home with you.

turns.say: Some husband. Your wife sneaks off with Graves and you sit there sweating.
Sit down, Mr Wu, I'm not finished.

revealed.ace_debt: Ace owed you eight thousand dollars for an import loan. Dead, he can never pay it back; his death ruins you.
revealed.went_looking: You did not stay at your table. At 11:01 you went to find Allison, and her dressing room was empty. In the dark back hall a woman brushed past you heading for the back stairs, wearing gardenia perfume; Allison wears jasmine. When the lights came on at 11:04 you saw Allison come out of the cloakroom with Harlan Graves.
